# ShipOS

> A GitHub repository workbench for evidence-based audits, launch assets, developer utilities, and demo production.

## Documentation

- [README](https://github.com/CodesbyFebin/Ship-Repo-OS/blob/main/README.md): Setup, modes, architecture, and API examples.
- [Workbench guide](https://github.com/CodesbyFebin/Ship-Repo-OS/blob/main/docs/workbench.md): Local audit, readiness and coverage, launch kit, and media commands.
- [Contributing](https://github.com/CodesbyFebin/Ship-Repo-OS/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md): Development and verification steps.
- [Security](https://github.com/CodesbyFebin/Ship-Repo-OS/blob/main/SECURITY.md): Disclosure and deployment boundaries.
- [Changelog](https://github.com/CodesbyFebin/Ship-Repo-OS/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md): Version history.
